# Capability Matrix

System capabilities and implementation status matrix.

*This file will contain the comprehensive capability matrix and will be auto-generated or updated with each release.*

## Capability Categories

- **Resource Management**: Process, memory, and I/O management
- **Synchronization**: Concurrency primitives and locking
- **Storage**: Filesystem and data persistence
- **Networking**: Network stack and protocols
- **Scheduling**: Task scheduling and prioritization
- **Security**: Access control and authentication

## Status Levels

| Status | Definition |
|--------|-----------|
| Implemented | Fully working in current release |
| In Development | Active work in progress |
| Planned | Scheduled for future release |
| Research | Under investigation, not yet scheduled |
| Deprecated | Superseded or no longer maintained |

See [feature-status.md](./feature-status.md) for detailed feature breakdown.
